items.briefing:
Two cyber threats worth your attention today: "device code phishing" attacks have surged 1,500% this year, where scammers trick you into approving fake login requests that hand over your account access. Voice phishing (vishing) — scam phone calls impersonating IT support or management — has also doubled. Both tactics are increasingly targeting workplace accounts. Separately, a security flaw in N-able remote management software is being actively exploited by attackers, so IT teams should ensure any such tools are fully patched.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected call or message asking you to approve a login or share a code, stop and verify the request directly with your IT team before doing anything.
